# Veylet crawler policy.
# Public pages are open to search engines and AI crawlers. Account, sign-in
# return, private handoff, owner preview and embed surfaces are private for
# every agent. A crawler obeys only the most specific group that names it, so
# the named group below repeats the same private paths. Disallow lines come
# first so parsers that apply the first matching rule read them the same way.

User-agent: *
Disallow: /account
Disallow: /auth
Disallow: /handoff
Disallow: /play
Disallow: /embed
Allow: /

# Search and AI crawlers, named explicitly: public pages allowed.
User-agent: GPTBot
User-agent: OAI-SearchBot
User-agent: ChatGPT-User
User-agent: ClaudeBot
User-agent: Claude-User
User-agent: PerplexityBot
User-agent: Google-Extended
User-agent: Bingbot
Disallow: /account
Disallow: /auth
Disallow: /handoff
Disallow: /play
Disallow: /embed
Allow: /

Sitemap: https://veylet.com/sitemap.xml
